latestVersion.changelog:
Initial launch — quickly turn text into AI-generated videos (1080p MP4) from chat prompts or file uploads.

- Converts text, TXT, DOCX, or PDF (≤500MB) into AI videos in 1–2 minutes using cloud GPUs
- No local software needed: simple chat prompts control generation, editing, and export
- Supports actions for exporting videos, uploading files, checking credits, and viewing project status
- Handles all error messages and account status transparently, guiding users throughout
- Output formats: MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, MKV, JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC
